name: @561-group/qwzspace
description: QuasiSpace (qwzspace) — the zero-dependency realtime webapp-game engine shared by Aletheon and other game services. It provides a fixed-tick single-writer transaction boundary, intent queue, interest-filtered snapshot projection, broadcast hub, and pluggable SSE and WebSocket transports. Domain state and persistence are injected through explicit interfaces; qwzspace does not depend on any particular substrate package.

scripts.test: node tests/prove-intent-queue.mjs && node tests/prove-snapshot-manager.mjs && node tests/prove-broadcast-hub.mjs && node tests/prove-protocol.mjs && node tests/prove-tick-driver.mjs && node tests/prove-create-server.mjs
